title: Interactive Slide Dispositions
description: Make all slides interactive by default: every disposition is hoverable, selectable (click + rectangle marquee with crossing/window rules), draggable, resizable, with per-disposition slide-fullscreen toggle. Ephemeral in-session only.
summary: Added ephemeral interactive manipulation to the React presentation renderer: every disposition is hoverable, selectable (click with shift-toggle, crossing/window marquee), draggable, resizable (8 handles, multi-select group ops), and slide-fullscreen via a small toggle. State resets on slide change/reload. Wired PresentationInteractionProvider into PresentationDeck, InteractionLayer behind placements for empty-area hit testing, geometry helpers with vitest coverage, and interaction CSS.
